svg.title: Exact boundary cancellation and volume reconstruction
svg.desc: For a=1 and forcing exp(-2r), the volume inverse plus its negative boundary correction gives the Dirichlet solution. The second panel displays the exact parametrix and its retained left error.
svg.text: L(f,g) = Vf + K S″ γVf + K Sg
K uses the full original boundary source.
𝒦 = −E − K S″ γE + K R₁ γ
The left error gains one derivative.
C γV = γEV − γVF gains N derivatives.
Every trace is taken above its proved threshold.
